metadata.title: Daily Air Quality bulletin for GERMANY

pollutant_summary_by_region.interpretation: Table Interpretation (to be included on the website as information): [Max concentration | timestamp of max value | AQI confidence score]. Maxima are the highest land-grid concentration inside the NUTS region polygon. Confidence is P(CAMS forecast AQI is correct) from the 3-hourly spatial-std model; hours between leads interpolate mu/sigma, 22-23 UTC clamp to 21 UTC.

region_leadtime_heatmap.interpretation: Each pollutant panel shows the hourly spatial-maximum concentration among land grid points in the region, coloured with European AQI thresholds. Box plots show the daily distribution of all land-grid values in each region.

transboundary_pollution.interpretation: Main contributors are the three largest sources of the city-mean concentration over lead hours 0-23. Source: CAMS Policy Tools country contribution (https://policy.atmosphere.copernicus.eu/daily/country-contribution/).
